DML.SELECT: SELECT element_type_id as "elementTypeId", element_id as "elementId", transit_type_id as "transitTypeId", infraction_manager_id as "infractionManagerId", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM conf.element_transit_types WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.element_transit_types (element_type_id, element_id, transit_type_id, infraction_manager_id, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:elementTypeId, :elementId, :transitTypeId, :infractionManagerId, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE conf.element_transit_types SET infraction_manager_id = :infractionManagerId, enabled = :enabled, visible = :visible, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE element_type_id = :elementTypeId AND element_id = :elementId AND transit_type_id = :transitTypeId
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM conf.element_transit_types WHERE element_type_id = :elementTypeId AND element_id = :elementId AND transit_type_id = :transitTypeId
